tracks.title: Laid to Rest
tracks.reason: Its mid-tempo, stutter-step kick patterns and locked-in groove are the exact rhythmic foundation we need for the main beat.

tracks.title: Mr. Self Destruct
tracks.reason: The complex layering of percussive noise and industrial loops provides a perfect model for our non-kit rhythmic parts.

tracks.title: FEEL NOTHING
tracks.reason: The track's use of a punishing, detuned, and abrasive synth lead as the main hook is a direct parallel for our 'Unstable Digital Lead'.
